import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Cutting {

    private static int[] parseIntegerArray(String s) {
        String[] parts = s.trim().split("\\s+");
        int[] result = new int[parts.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
            result[i] = Integer.parseInt(parts[i]);
        }
        return result;
    }

    private static boolean isBalancedSubarray(int[] arr, int endIndex) {
        int evenCount = 0;
        int oddCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= endIndex; i++) {
            if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) {
                evenCount++;
            } else {
                oddCount++;
            }
        }
        return evenCount == oddCount;
    }

    private static int findMinimumCostValidCut(int[] arr, int totalCoins, Map<Integer, Boolean> usedCuts) {
        int minCost = totalCoins + 1;
        int bestIndex = -1;
        int length = arr.length;

        for (int i = 1; i < length - 1; i++) {
            int cost = Math.abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]);
            if (cost < minCost && isBalancedSubarray(arr, i) && !usedCuts.containsKey(i)) {
                minCost = cost;
                bestIndex = i;
            }
        }
        return bestIndex;
    }

    public int computeMaximumCuts(int n, int budget, int[] values) {
        int remainingCoins = budget;
        int cutCount = 0;
        Map<Integer, Boolean> usedCuts = new HashMap<>();

        while (remainingCoins > 0) {
            int cutIndex = findMinimumCostValidCut(values, remainingCoins, usedCuts);
            if (cutIndex == -1) {
                break;
            }
            usedCuts.put(cutIndex, true);
            remainingCoins -= Math.abs(values[cutIndex] - values[cutIndex + 1]);
            cutCount++;
        }
        return cutCount;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        BufferedWriter writer = new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out));

        int[] firstLine = parseIntegerArray(reader.readLine());
        int[] secondLine = parseIntegerArray(reader.readLine());

        Cutting cutter = new Cutting();
        int result = cutter.computeMaximumCuts(firstLine[0], firstLine[1], secondLine);

        writer.write(String.valueOf(result));
        writer.newLine();
        writer.flush();
    }
}

public class Cutting {

                     .mapToInt(Integer::parseInt)
                     .toArray();
    }

    private static boolean checkBalance(int[] nums, int limit) {
        int even = 0, odd = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= limit; i++) {
            if (nums[i] % 2 == 0) even++;
            else odd++;
        }
        return even == odd;
    }

    private static int findBestPosition(int[] values, int funds, Set<Integer> exclusions) {
        int bestIndex = -1;
        int lowestCost = funds + 1;

        for (int i = 1; i < values.length - 1; i++) {
            int cost = Math.abs(values[i] - values[i + 1]);
            if (cost < lowestCost && checkBalance(values, i) && !exclusions.contains(i)) {
                lowestCost = cost;
                bestIndex = i;
            }
        }
        return bestIndex;
    }

    public int computeOptimalCuts(int itemCount, int coinBudget, int[] coinValues) {
        int currentCoins = coinBudget;
        int cutCount = 0;
        Set<Integer> occupied = new HashSet<>();

        while (currentCoins > 0) {
            int position = findBestPosition(coinValues, currentCoins, occupied);
            if (position == -1) break;

            occupied.add(position);
            currentCoins -= Math.abs(coinValues[position] - coinValues[position + 1]);
            cutCount++;
        }
        return cutCount;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] first = reader.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
        String[] second = reader.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
